```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
from scvi.model import SCANVI
import harmonypy as hm
import anndata
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# 1. Load reference and select reference HVGs
# ============================================================

ref = sc.read("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")

sc.pl.umap(ref, color="labels")

sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    ref,
    n_top_genes=2000,
    batch_key="GEX_id",
    subset=True
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Load query and prepare it to match reference genes
# ============================================================

query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

gene1 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD19_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

gene2 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD22_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

query = query[
    (gene1 > 0.5) | (gene2 > 0.5)
].copy()

query.obs["Timepoint_bin"] = query.obs["Timepoint"]



query = query[
    query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].isin(["d14", "d150", "Product"])
].copy()

query = query[:, ref.var_names].copy()


# ============================================================
# 3. Train SCVI on the reference
# ============================================================

scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(
    ref,
    layer="counts"
)

model = scvi.model.SCVI(ref)

model.train()


# ============================================================
# 4. Train SCANVI using the reference labels
# ============================================================

scanvi_model = SCANVI.from_scvi_model(
    model,
    unlabeled_category="Unknown",
    labels_key="labels"
)

scanvi_model.train()


# ============================================================
# 5. Get SCANVI latent representation for reference
# ============================================================

SCANVI_LATENT_KEY = "X_scANVI"
SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY = "predictions_scanvi"

ref.obsm[SCANVI_LATENT_KEY] = (
    scanvi_model.get_latent_representation()
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Map query onto the reference SCANVI model
# ============================================================

scvi.model.SCANVI.prepare_query_anndata(
    query,
    scanvi_model
)

scanvi_query = scvi.model.SCANVI.load_query_data(
    query,
    scanvi_model
)

scanvi_query.train(
    max_epochs=200
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Get query SCANVI latent representation + predictions
# ============================================================

query.obsm[SCANVI_LATENT_KEY] = (
    scanvi_query.get_latent_representation()
)

query.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY] = (
    scanvi_query.predict()
)

prediction_probs = scanvi_query.predict(query, soft=True)

query.obs["scanvi_score"] = prediction_probs.max(axis=1)

ref.obs["scanvi_score"] = np.nan

# ============================================================
# 8. Check query predictions
# ============================================================

print(query.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY].value_counts())


# ============================================================
# 9. Combine reference + query for a new joint embedding
# ============================================================

ref.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY] = ref.obs["labels"]

full = anndata.concat(
    [ref, query],
    label="source",
    join="inner"
)

sc.pp.neighbors(
    full,
    use_rep=SCANVI_LATENT_KEY
)

sc.tl.umap(full)


# ============================================================
# 10. Plot the new joint embedding
# ============================================================

sc.pl.umap(
    full,
    color=[
        "source",
        "Timepoint_bin",
        "labels",
        "predictions_scanvi",
        "CD4", "CD8A"
    ],
    cmap="magma_r",
    frameon=False,
    ncols=2
)
```

# running scvi integration instead of reference mapping as there is clearly a batch effect
```{python}
ref = sc.read("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")

query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

# again selectf or CAR+ cells
gene1 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD19_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

gene2 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD22_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

query = query[
    (gene1 > 0.5) | (gene2 > 0.5)
].copy()

#and remove the healthies (their timpeoint is NA)
query.obs["Timepoint_bin"] = query.obs["Timepoint"]

query = query[
    query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].isin(["d14", "d150", "Product"])
].copy()

query.obs["Source"] = query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].map({
    "d14": "PB",
    "d150": "PB",
    "Product": "PROD"
})

query.obs["labels"] = "Unknown" 

common_genes = ref.var_names.intersection(query.var_names)

ref = ref[:, common_genes].copy()
query = query[:, common_genes].copy()
```

```{python}
full_int = anndata.concat(
    [ref, query],
    label="study",
    keys=["carpall_one", "carpall_three"],
    join="inner"
)

full_int.obs["sample_id"] = (
    full_int.obs["Patient"].astype(str) + "_" +
    full_int.obs["Timepoint_bin"].astype(str) + "_" +
    full_int.obs["Source"].astype(str)
)
```

```{python}
print(full_int.obs["sample_id"].value_counts())
```

```{python}
# ---- keep a full-gene copy for downstream expression work ----
full_int_allgenes = full_int.copy()

# ---- HVGs, now actually subset for the model input ----
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    full_int,
    n_top_genes=2000,
    batch_key="sample_id",
    subset=False   # keep as-is here so var["highly_variable"] is annotated
)

full_int_hvg = full_int[:, full_int.var["highly_variable"]].copy()

full_int_hvg.write_h5ad("carpall_full_scanvi_input.h5ad")
full_int_allgenes.write_h5ad("carpall_full_allgenes.h5ad")  # for later expression lookups
```

```{python}
# ==== this chunk runs on the cluster ====

full_int_hvg = sc.read("carpall_full_scanvi_input.h5ad")

# make sure query cells are labeled "Unknown" for scANVI
LABEL_KEY = "labels"   # <-- replace with your actual cohort-1 label column
UNLABELED_CATEGORY = "Unknown"

full_int_hvg.obs[LABEL_KEY] = full_int_hvg.obs[LABEL_KEY].astype(str)
full_int_hvg.obs.loc[
    full_int_hvg.obs["study"] == "carpall_three", LABEL_KEY
] = UNLABELED_CATEGORY

# ---- Step 1: setup + train base SCVI model with Patient as covariate ----
scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(
    full_int_hvg,
    layer="counts",
    batch_key="study"
)

model_scvi = scvi.model.SCVI(
    full_int_hvg,
    n_latent=30,
    n_layers=2,
    gene_likelihood="nb"
)

model_scvi.train(max_epochs=400, early_stopping=True)

# sanity check convergence before moving on
model_scvi.history["elbo_train"].plot()

# ---- Step 2: initialize scANVI from the trained SCVI model ----
model_scanvi = scvi.model.SCANVI.from_scvi_model(
    model_scvi,
    unlabeled_category=UNLABELED_CATEGORY,
    labels_key=LABEL_KEY
)

model_scanvi.train(max_epochs=200, early_stopping=True)
model_scanvi.history["elbo_train"].plot()

# ---- Step 3: get latent rep + predicted labels for query cells ----
full_int_hvg.obsm["X_scANVI"] = model_scanvi.get_latent_representation()
full_int_hvg.obs["scanvi_predicted"] = model_scanvi.predict()

sc.pp.neighbors(full_int_hvg, use_rep="X_scANVI")
sc.tl.umap(full_int_hvg)

model_scanvi.save("scanvi_model/", overwrite=True)
full_int_hvg.write_h5ad("carpall_full_scanvi_corrected.h5ad")
```

```{python}
# ---- Step 4: bring latent rep + predictions back onto full-gene object ----
full_int_hvg = sc.read("carpall_full_scanvi_corrected.h5ad")
full_int_allgenes = sc.read("carpall_full_allgenes.h5ad")

# obs order is preserved from the shared full_int, so this direct assignment is safe
full_int_allgenes.obsm["X_scANVI"] = full_int_hvg.obsm["X_scANVI"]
full_int_allgenes.obs["scanvi_predicted"] = full_int_hvg.obs["scanvi_predicted"].values
full_int_allgenes.obsm["X_umap"] = full_int_hvg.obsm["X_umap"]

full_int_allgenes.write_h5ad("carpall_full_allgenes_with_scanvi.h5ad")
```
